messages:
Alice Nguyen: Hey team — scheduled cutover for 'orbit-lite' at 12:15 UTC today. Quick pre-deploy checklist below; please ack and call out blockers. @ben @dana @carlos @eliott @deploy-bot
Alice Nguyen: Pre-deploy checklist (quick):
  • staging smoke ✅
  • DB feature flag toggle (off -> on) ✅
  • canary plan: start 10% (hold)
  • rollback runbook confirmed
  • observability/alerts enabled
  • warm KV cache before shift
Please reply with ack or blockers by 12:05 UTC.

Ben Patel: staging smoke passed at 11:10 UTC. Running quick smoke now: `./scripts/smoke.sh --suite=quick` — all endpoints 200, embeddings <120ms. :ok_hand:

Dana Kim: DB migration is non-breaking, feature flag change is in PR #5234 and staged. I will flip the flag at cutover time (12:14 UTC). No schema changes.

Carlos Rivera: Suggest we start at 5% for 15m then go to 10% for 30m if metrics look good. Also request we freeze model switching during rollout window. Any objections? @alice

Alice Nguyen: good call on the stagger. Freeze model switches = yes. Add liveness check to checklist: `curl -fS https://prod.labs.redwood-inference/v1/health` — want someone to run this after warm cache.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled — start=2245678901, eta=12:15 UTC, lane=canary-10pct, owner=@Alice Nguyen, rollback-owner=@Eliott

Eliott: Oncall here — alerts and dashboards pinned, runbook link posted in #incidents. I'll own rollback. If error-rate >1% or p95 spikes >2x, we roll back and page.

Ben Patel: Question — do we want to warm KV cache? I can run `python scripts/warm_cache.py --keys=top-1000` ~5m prior.

Alice Nguyen: yes please warm the cache, Ben. Ownership breakdown: Ben — smoke & warming, Dana — flag toggle, Carlos — metrics owner, Eliott — rollback. If no objections by 12:05 we proceed. :thumbsup:

Carlos Rivera: ack. I'll watch p50/p95, error-rate, model error logs; will call 'go' at 12:20 if stable.

Ben Patel: warming cache now, will post when done.

Dana Kim: will toggle flag at 12:14 UTC and confirm once flipped.

Eliott: alerts on, runbook ready, I'll be standing by.

Ben Patel: warm cache complete. all keys primed, latency check post-warm: p50 90ms / p95 160ms.

Dana Kim: flag toggled at 12:14:35 UTC — monitoring.

Alice Nguyen: final ack from owners — please reply with 'ack' or :thumbsup: so I can start the canary roll.

Ben Patel: ack :thumbsup:

Dana Kim: ack

Carlos Rivera: ack

Eliott: ack

Alice Nguyen: launching canary now (starting traffic shift). I'll post updates in this thread.

Ben Patel: initial canary 5% started (per Carlos' suggestion), observing metrics.

Carlos Rivera: metrics look clean at +10m, p95 stable, no error increase. holding for 15m then bump to 10%.

Alice Nguyen: great — thanks everyone. If anything trips, rollback plan = immediate traffic pull + feature flag rollback, Eliott will coordinate pages.
